Step by step

  1. The offer is signed

    As soon as the candidate signs in Inkpost, onboarding starts. Nobody has to remember to forward the letter.

  2. The employee record is created

    Title, manager, start date and work location are copied into Peoplebase, so payroll and benefits start from the same facts.

  3. The right laptop is ordered

    Engineering hires get the developer build; everyone else gets the standard build. Shipping is timed to arrive two days before the start date.

  4. Accounts are ready on day one

    Email, chat and calendar are created in advance and switched on at 8:00 AM local time on the first day, not before.

  5. The manager gets a plan

    A checklist arrives in Murmur with the first-week plan, a suggested buddy and a reminder for the 30-day check-in.

When things don't go to plan

The exceptions are where manual processes break down. These are handled out of the box.

  • Start date moves

    the laptop shipment and account activation move with it.

  • Offer is withdrawn

    every step taken so far is reversed and the laptop order is cancelled if it hasn't shipped.

  • Remote hire in another country

    the laptop is ordered from the regional supplier set for that country.

  • Rehire

    the old employee record is reactivated instead of a duplicate being created.
